name: patch_url_protection_bypass
description:
Change protection bypass for an alias or deployment URL. Depending on requestBody, it creates a shareable link that bypasses Vercel Authentication (never expires unless ttl is set), revokes and optionally regenerates a link, grants or denies a user's scoped access by user ID or email, or creates or revokes the alias protection override.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /aliases/{id}/protection-bypass --method PATCH. Fill placeholders from inputs.

revoke.description: Optional instructions for revoking and regenerating a shareable link

regenerate.description: Whether or not a new shareable link should be created after the provided secret is revoked

ttl.description: Optional time the shareable link is valid for in seconds. If not provided, the shareable link will never expire.

access.description: Invitation status for the user scoped bypass.

email.description: Specified email for the scoped bypass.

userId.description: Specified user id for the scoped bypass.

scope.description: Instructions for creating a user scoped protection bypass

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
